title: Chinese Podcast Site Launches: Is 4K Worth It?
titleZh: 中文版播客上线，4K值不值？
description: Steven tests a three-way recording setup built around the Blackmagic Camera app, works out how much storage 4K video eats up, and launches a GitHub site that turns the podcast into Chinese reading material with an interactive reader. He also explains why he's not interested in the 'vibe-cloned' Adobe software going around this weekend.

sentences.zh: 内容速览
sentences.en: Quick Overview

sentences.zh: 这期节目是史蒂文在周二晚上录的。
sentences.en: Steven recorded this episode on Tuesday evening.

sentences.zh: 他刚在镜头测试和 AI 项目上忙了三四个小时，嗓子有点哑，但对进展很满意。
sentences.en: He had just spent three or four hours on camera tests and AI projects, and his voice is a bit hoarse, but he's very happy with the progress.

sentences.zh: 他试用了围绕 Blackmagic Camera 应用搭建的新录制方案，算清了 4K 视频占多少存储空间，还宣布了一个大里程碑：一个用中文呈现播客的公开 GitHub 网站。
sentences.en: He tried out a new recording setup built around the Blackmagic Camera app, worked out how much storage 4K video takes up, and announced a big milestone: a public GitHub website that presents the podcast in Chinese.

sentences.zh: 最后，他对本周末刷屏的“凭感觉克隆”Adobe 软件泼了一盆冷水。
sentences.en: Finally, he pours cold water on the "vibe-cloned" Adobe software that flooded everyone's feeds this weekend.

sentences.zh: 取景难题与 Blackmagic Camera
sentences.en: The framing problem and Blackmagic Camera

sentences.zh: 史蒂文想开始在社交媒体上发视频，所以画质必须提升。
sentences.en: Steven wants to start posting videos on social media, so his image quality has to improve.

sentences.zh: iPhone 的后置摄像头画面最好，可录制时看不到取景，构图全靠猜。
sentences.en: The iPhone's rear camera gives the best picture, but you can't see the framing while recording, so composing the shot is pure guesswork.

sentences.zh: 外接监视器大约 50 加元（约 250 元人民币），也不算太贵，但出门又多一件行李。
sentences.en: An external monitor costs about 50 Canadian dollars (around 250 RMB), which isn't too expensive, but it's one more thing to carry when going out.

sentences.zh: 他便想，为什么没有软件能把镜头画面同步出来？
sentences.en: So he wondered: why isn't there software that can mirror the camera's feed?

sentences.zh: 原来 Blackmagic Camera 就能做到。
sentences.en: It turns out Blackmagic Camera can do exactly that.

sentences.zh: 他有 DaVinci Resolve Studio，却很少用，称它是“复杂得吓人的软件”，平时剪辑还是靠 Final Cut Pro。
sentences.en: He has DaVinci Resolve Studio but rarely uses it, calling it "terrifyingly complicated software"; for everyday editing he still relies on Final Cut Pro.

sentences.zh: Blackmagic 的相机应用在发烧友和专业人士中很有名，比苹果的 Final Cut Camera 专业得多，后者够用，就是不能监看画面。
sentences.en: Blackmagic's camera app is well known among enthusiasts and professionals and is far more professional than Apple's Final Cut Camera; the latter is good enough, except that it can't monitor the picture.

sentences.zh: 一次录三份
sentences.en: Recording three copies at once

sentences.zh: 之前的测试让小米、GoPro、MacBook 和 iPhone 同场比拼，iPhone 在画质和压缩上胜出，短板是声音。
sentences.en: An earlier test pitted a Xiaomi, a GoPro, a MacBook and an iPhone against each other; the iPhone won on image quality and compression, and its weak point was the sound.

sentences.zh: 现在每期节目同时有三份录音：
sentences.en: Now every episode has three recordings at the same time:

sentences.zh: iPhone 视频：自带麦克风录下的声音当备份音频
sentences.en: iPhone video: the sound recorded by its built-in microphone serves as backup audio

sentences.zh: MacBook 上的 QuickTime：用 Shure MV7+ 麦克风录一份 720p 备份视频
sentences.en: QuickTime on the MacBook: records a 720p backup video using the Shure MV7+ microphone

sentences.zh: Logic Pro：听众听到的主音轨，要经过“一整套花里胡哨的剪辑”
sentences.en: Logic Pro: the main audio track that listeners hear, which goes through "a whole bunch of fancy editing"

sentences.zh: 今天 iPhone 架在 MacBook 上方，运行 Blackmagic Camera，他用 Mac 上的 iPad 版应用来遥控。
sentences.en: Today the iPhone is mounted above the MacBook running Blackmagic Camera, and he controls it remotely with the iPad version of the app on his Mac.

sentences.zh: 他本想双机位加双音轨，可 Mac 版不录音，只好说一句“行吧，随便”。
sentences.en: He had wanted two camera angles plus two audio tracks, but the Mac version doesn't record audio, so he could only say, "Fine, whatever."

sentences.zh: 这套方案出差也好带，只多一个磁吸支架。
sentences.en: This setup is also easy to take on trips; it only adds one magnetic mount.

sentences.zh: 测试结果：阳光称王
sentences.en: Test results: sunlight reigns supreme

sentences.zh: 最大的发现是：“阳光征服一切，阳光统治一切。”
sentences.en: The biggest discovery was: "Sunlight conquers everything, sunlight rules everything."

sentences.zh: 不管用什么相机、什么码率，光线对画面的影响最明显。
sentences.en: No matter which camera or bitrate is used, lighting has the most obvious effect on the image.

sentences.zh: 这对今天可是个麻烦，因为他晚上 7 点 48 分才开录。
sentences.en: That's a real problem for today, because he didn't start recording until 7:48 in the evening.

sentences.zh: Claude 把结果整理成一张对比表。
sentences.en: Claude organized the results into a comparison table.

sentences.zh: 结论是：Shure 麦克风胜过 iPhone 自带麦克风，iPhone 14 Pro Max 后摄的压缩效果是他所有设备里最好的。
sentences.en: The conclusion: the Shure microphone beats the iPhone's built-in mic, and the iPhone 14 Pro Max rear camera's compression is the best of all his devices.

sentences.zh: 就连 Blackmagic 的 HEVC 设置，也只多拍到一点点细节。
sentences.en: Even Blackmagic's HEVC setting captured only a tiny bit more detail.

sentences.zh: 存储空间的账
sentences.en: The storage math

sentences.zh: 720p 的 QuickTime 文件每期约 4 GB，iPhone 的 4K 文件约 17 GB，今天 Blackmagic 的录制估计要 18 到 19 GB。
sentences.en: A 720p QuickTime file is about 4 GB per episode, an iPhone 4K file is about 17 GB, and today's Blackmagic recording will probably be 18 to 19 GB.

sentences.zh: 每周五期，就是大约 100 GB。
sentences.en: With five episodes a week, that's about 100 GB.

sentences.zh: 他的硬盘有 5 TB，五年下来要占掉大约 30 TB，这些数据“白占着地方，却不再带来任何回报”。
sentences.en: His hard drive is 5 TB, and over five years this would take up about 30 TB — data that "just sits there taking up space without giving anything back."

sentences.zh: 他多半会降到 1080p，还开玩笑说自己没那么执着于“给子孙后代留下我额头的皱纹”。
sentences.en: He'll most likely drop down to 1080p, joking that he isn't that set on "preserving the wrinkles on my forehead for future generations."

sentences.zh: 反正传到 YouTube 后原片也要压缩，“那一开始为什么要拍 4K 呢？”
sentences.en: After all, the original footage gets compressed once it's uploaded to YouTube anyway, "so why shoot in 4K in the first place?"

sentences.zh: 中文版播客上线 GitHub
sentences.en: Chinese version of the podcast launches on GitHub

sentences.zh: 最大的新闻是一个新的 GitHub Pages 网站，收录播客的中文版：stevensirski.github.io/ssab-zh。
sentences.en: The biggest news is a new GitHub Pages website hosting the Chinese version of the podcast: stevensirski.github.io/ssab-zh.

sentences.zh: 一年半来，史蒂文一直在为节目生成 AI 摘要。
sentences.en: For the past year and a half, Steven has been generating AI summaries for the show.

sentences.zh: 本来想做成时事通讯文章，可摘要质量不够稳定，没法发布，而他也不打算天天校对文字稿。
sentences.en: He originally wanted to turn them into newsletter articles, but the summaries weren't consistent enough in quality to publish, and he didn't plan to proofread transcripts every day.

sentences.zh: 于是他把摘要变成了学习材料。
sentences.en: So he turned the summaries into study material.

sentences.zh: 学中文不同于学字母文字，他认为真正贯穿整门语言的是汉字。
sentences.en: Learning Chinese is different from learning an alphabetic language; he believes what truly runs through the whole language is the characters.

sentences.zh: 这些话题他能说，却读不了，熟悉的内容正好给新汉字提供了“抓手”。
sentences.en: He can talk about these topics but can't read them, so the familiar content gives new characters a "handhold."

sentences.zh: 网站上有中文摘要，还有 ElevenLabs 的 AI 声音“明瑶”朗读的 MP3。
sentences.en: The website has the Chinese summaries, plus MP3s read by "Mingyao," an AI voice from ElevenLabs.

sentences.zh: 他坦言，很多字自己还是跟不上。
sentences.en: He admits that there are still many characters he can't keep up with.

sentences.zh: 住在他 Mac 里的工作流
sentences.en: The workflow that lives in his Mac

sentences.zh: 这条流水线每天自动运行：转写、摘要、中文和俄语翻译、MP3、竖屏短片，直到发布到 GitHub。
sentences.en: This pipeline runs automatically every day, covering transcription, summaries, Chinese and Russian translations, MP3s and vertical short videos, all the way to publishing on GitHub.

sentences.zh: 起点是他把视频文件丢进 MacBook 上的一个文件夹，然后 Claude 调用 Python、FFmpeg 等开源工具。
sentences.en: It starts when he drops a video file into a folder on his MacBook, and then Claude calls open-source tools such as Python and FFmpeg.

sentences.zh: 它依赖他的电脑，所以上个月去多伦多、穿越美国时手边只有手机，这套流程根本跑不起来。
sentences.en: It depends on his computer, so last month, when he went to Toronto and travelled across the US with only his phone, the whole process simply couldn't run.

sentences.zh: 英文版网站几天内上线。
sentences.en: The English version of the website will go live within a few days.

sentences.zh: 他还想用子域名，不过他自嘲：“怎么会不知道怎么设子域名？我就是不明白。”
sentences.en: He also wants to use a subdomain, though he jokes about himself: "How can I not know how to set up a subdomain? I just don't get it."

sentences.zh: GitHub 最容易接入 Claude，还能充当异地备份，目前在中国也能访问。
sentences.en: GitHub is the easiest to connect to Claude, can also serve as an off-site backup, and is currently accessible in China too.

sentences.zh: 互动阅读器与下一步
sentences.en: The interactive reader and next steps

sentences.zh: 阅读器仿照 Du Chinese：点一个词，就能看到拼音和英文。
sentences.en: The reader is modeled on Du Chinese: tap a word and you can see its pinyin and English.

sentences.zh: 目前能播放整句，还不能单独播放一个词。
sentences.en: Right now it can play whole sentences, but it can't yet play a single word on its own.

sentences.zh: GitHub 的 1 GB 容量上限迟早逼他对存档做决定，也许按年滚动。
sentences.en: GitHub's 1 GB storage limit will sooner or later force him to make a decision about the archive, perhaps rolling it over by year.

sentences.zh: 每期还有一份十个词的“重点词汇”，比如“模块化”。
sentences.en: Each episode also has a ten-word "key vocabulary" list, for example "modularization".

sentences.zh: 他还在考虑加一个语法板块，因为学习者总爱把母语语法“硬塞”进所学的语言。
sentences.en: He is also considering adding a grammar section, because learners always tend to "force" their native-language grammar into the language they're learning.

sentences.zh: 目前还没人校对过中文，这只是个业余项目，但他仍称之为“意义重大的一步，质的飞跃”。
sentences.en: No one has proofread the Chinese yet, and it's just a hobby project, but he still calls it "a significant step, a qualitative leap".

sentences.zh: “凭感觉克隆”的 Adobe 软件：不了，谢谢
sentences.en: "Vibe-cloned" Adobe software: no thanks

sentences.zh: 关于这些克隆版 Adobe 软件，一个 YouTube 视频就足以让史蒂文打消念头。
sentences.en: As for these cloned Adobe programs, a single YouTube video was enough to put Steven off the idea.

sentences.zh: 开源替代品早就有了：Audacity、Kdenlive、Blender、Inkscape、OpenOffice。
sentences.en: Open-source alternatives have been around for a long time: Audacity, Kdenlive, Blender, Inkscape, OpenOffice.

sentences.zh: 他的评价是：“真麻烦。”
sentences.en: His verdict: "What a hassle."

sentences.zh: 用起来麻烦，更新维护更麻烦。
sentences.en: They're a hassle to use, and updating and maintaining them is even more of a hassle.

sentences.zh: “凭感觉写代码来当你的老师”也是一样。
sentences.en: The same goes for "vibe-coding your own teacher."

sentences.zh: 做出一次只能证明你做得到，之后还得维护。
sentences.en: Building it once only proves you can do it; afterwards you still have to maintain it.

sentences.zh: 真人老师会把你推向新方向，AI 却往往顺着兔子洞越钻越深。
sentences.en: A real teacher pushes you in new directions, while AI tends to follow you deeper and deeper down the rabbit hole.

sentences.zh: 作者做这些软件是出于报复，因为 Adobe 拒绝退还违约金。
sentences.en: The author made these programs out of revenge, because Adobe refused to refund an early-termination fee.

sentences.zh: 源代码免费，AI 功能却要买点数：“换了个名字的 AI 创业套路。”
sentences.en: The source code is free, but the AI features require buying credits: "the AI startup playbook under a different name."

sentences.zh: 史蒂文说，你不再每月付 Adobe 30 美元，而是付 Claude 30 美元。
sentences.en: Steven says that instead of paying Adobe $30 a month, you pay Claude $30.

sentences.zh: 他的下一步是学会用提示词让 AI 替他剪辑并发布。
sentences.en: His next step is learning to use prompts to get AI to edit and publish for him.

sentences.zh: 今日总结
sentences.en: Today's summary

sentences.zh: 新工具确实好用，但史蒂文真正的进步，来自按自己的目标去改造它们，比如借着自己关心的话题来读中文。
sentences.en: The new tools really are useful, but Steven's real progress comes from reshaping them around his own goals, such as reading Chinese through topics he cares about.

sentences.zh: 他也清楚代价：存储空间、维护精力和订阅费用。
sentences.en: He is also clear about the costs: storage space, maintenance effort, and subscription fees.

vocab.en: to frame a shot / compose the view
a handle; something to hold onto or build on
